1. Purpose

This roadmap defines the complete development process for transforming the existing Wallpaper Gallery website into a polished Android application using Capacitor. It provides a clear sequence of tasks, ensuring development remains organized, efficient, and focused on Version 1 goals.

2. Development Strategy

The project will follow an incremental enhancement approach rather than a complete rewrite.

Core principles:

Improve existing functionality.
Redesign the UI/UX.
Keep the codebase simple.
Test continuously.
Convert to Android only after the web app is stable.

6. Development Rules

Throughout development:

Complete one feature at a time.
Test after every major change.
Avoid unnecessary rewrites.
Keep commits small and meaningful.
Maintain consistent code quality.
Update documentation when requirements change.

8. Definition of Done

A phase is considered complete only when:

All planned tasks are implemented.
Code is reviewed.
No critical bugs remain.
UI matches the approved design.
Documentation is updated.
Feature passes testing.
9. Risks & Mitigation
Risk	Mitigation
UI changes during development	Finalize designs before coding
API rate limits	Use caching and optimize requests
Performance issues	Test regularly on real devices
Capacitor integration issues	Integrate after web app is stable
Scope creep	Follow Version 1 requirements only
10. Success Metrics

The roadmap is successful when:

All documentation is complete.
UI/UX is finalized.
All Version 1 features are implemented.
The app performs smoothly on Android.
No critical issues remain.
The application is ready for production release.
